gap: No result ChatGPT got states that two of the four products ChatGPT showed as cards were unavailable at the store it linked on 2026-11-10: the iHome iBT330 ($30.99 at ihome.com, page shows 'Sold out') and the Studebaker SB2006 ($59.99 at Target, 'Out of Stock'). The Studebaker is ChatGPT's only rechargeable AM/FM pick, so the only AM pick still buyable is the $179.99 Tivoli Model One BT, which runs on a power supply. Every Avantree pick is sold as FM only.
standout_why: I compared against itechguides 'Best Bluetooth Speakers with FM Radio: 3 Top Picks', itechguides '5 Sangean Models Compared', rottenwifi '10 Best Bluetooth Speakers With AM/FM Radio' and Best Buy's 'Portable Bluetooth Speakers With FM Radio' listing. The itechguides and rottenwifi pages give Amazon prices dated Nov 9 for different products: ION Tailgater, DEWALT DCR028B, PRUNUS, Yewrich and BUFFBEE. They give no price for the Avantree PowerByte, and their only Tivoli price ($179.99) was observed in August 2026. None of them gives a price or stock status for the iHome iBT330 or the Studebaker SB2006. rottenwifi lists the PowerByte as 'AM/FM (flagged to verify)', but Avantree's own store sells it only as an 'FM Radio' speaker, so the rival lists AM without support. The Sangean page lists five AM/FM models with no prices, and four of them have no battery.
decides: For a shopper who needs AM, ChatGPT's cheap AM option (the rechargeable Studebaker SB2006 at $59.99) can't be bought from Target today. The iHome iBT330 is FM only and also sold out at ihome.com. That leaves FM-only Avantree models ($34.99–$99.99) or the mains-powered Tivoli Model One BT at $179.99. The pick splits by band. For FM only, the Avantree BoomByte ($59.99 at both Avantree and Best Buy) or the PowerByte ($99.99) is in stock today. For AM/FM with a battery, none of ChatGPT's in-stock picks qualifies, so the page needs a sourced AM/FM rechargeable alternative.
